mapper.select: SELECT A.ADDRESS_ID AS addressId, A.ADDRESS_ALIAS AS addressAlias, A.ZIPCODE AS zipcode, A.ADDRESS AS address, A.DETAILED_ADDRESS AS detailedAddress, A.DEFAULT_YN AS defaultYn, U.USER_NAME AS receiverName, U.USER_PHONE AS receiverPhone FROM USER_ADDRESS A INNER JOIN `USER` U ON A.USER_ID = U.USER_ID WHERE A.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY CASE A.DEFAULT_YN WHEN 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, A.ADDRESS_ID DESC

select.if: SELECT c.cart_id AS cartId, c.quantity AS quantity, c.cart_type AS cartType, c.user_id AS userId, c.product_id AS productId, c.option_id AS optionId, c.rental_start AS rentalStart, c.rental_end AS rentalEnd, p.product_name AS productName, p.price AS price, b.brand_name AS brandName, o.option_value AS optionName, ( SELECT img_url FROM PRODUCT_IMG WHERE product_id = c.product_id AND is_main = 'Y' LIMIT 1 ) AS imgUrl FROM CART c INNER JOIN PRODUCT p ON c.product_id = p.product_id LEFT JOIN BRAND b ON p.brand_id = b.brand_id LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_OPTION o ON c.option_id = o.option_id WHERE c.cart_id IN (${cartIds}) ORDER BY c.created_at DESC
